newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gan sees full year loss.
newsitem.headline: Gan sees full year loss.

text.p: French insurance group GAN expects a full year net loss but the figure would not necessarily be twice the first half loss, its chairman said on Wednesday.
The company earlier revealed a first-half loss of 965 million francs because of exposure to a moribund French property market and raised the prospect of a capital injection before it is privatised.
Chairman Jean-Jacques Bonnaud told a news conference that the banking losses on real estate, 1.8 billion francs, could be at the same level in the second half of the year.
In 1995, GAN made a net attributable loss of 1.8 billion francs.
